ACT II OF 1995
ACT II OF 1995
SINDH FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Finance Act, 1964
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd June, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-3/95, dated
22-6-1995.---The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 12th March; 19.95 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 4th April, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement. ---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 27th day of October,
1994.

Amendment of section 12 of West Pakistan Act No. XXXIV of 1964

ACT II OF 1995
ACT II OF 1995
SINDH FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Finance Act, 1964
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd June, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-3/95, dated
22-6-1995.---The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 12th March; 19.95 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 4th April, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 12 of West Pakistan Act No. XXXIV of 1964.-- In
the Sindh Finance Act, 1964, in section 12---
(i) in subsection (1), for the
words "eighteen paisa", the words "one rupee" shall be
substituted:---
(ii) for subsection (2),
including the proviso, the following shall be substituted;
"(2) The
incidence of the cases shall be shared at the rate of seventy five paisa and
twenty five-paisa by the Sugar Mills and the person selling the sugarcane to
the Mills, respectively:
Provided that in
the case of sugarcane obtained from the Sugar Mill's own farm, the cess, at the
rate of one rupee per maund, shall be paid by the Mill."
